facts.fact: The OQSF-CI executive secretary said that by the end of 2025, 1,879 people had interacted with artificial intelligence in the observatory's tools; the captured text does not name the system.

CIV.note: Not stated for a listed sector.

facts.fact: The OQSF-CI executive secretary said the observatory hosts a conciliation and mediation mechanism for amicable settlement of disputes, which any consumer of financial services can use free of charge; the text does not say it covers digital financial services in particular.

CIV.note: Consumer ratings concern financial providers, not public services.
